caption: The video captures a surfer in a dark wetsuit riding a short white surfboard along the shoulder of a breaking wave, a fan-shaped plume of spray rising behind him. He holds a low crouched stance with one arm extended as the board planes roughly horizontal on the water. White foam fills the left of the frame while two other surfers are visible in the background, one lying prone on a board. As the ride progresses the board's nose lifts and rotates toward a vertical orientation, the surfer tucking low over the rail. A rounded cloud of spray forms around him, briefly enveloping and obscuring the board during the turn. When the spray subsides the board returns to a horizontal planing position and the surfer resumes a crouched stance with spray kicking up behind. He continues traveling along the wave face toward the right of the frame.
